label: Q-03
title: No rescue path: stray non-strategy ERC20s and ERC1155 ids are stuck forever; stray strategy tokens/reward/ETH are swept to the next caller via whole-balance logic
description: Stateless whole-balance design (ethOut = address(this).balance; whole-balance NFT refund and token sales) with no owner sweep.
impact: Mistakenly-sent value is a gift to the next caller or permanently stuck. code-scan clearedRows (wholeBalancePayout/forcedEth) refuted the MR-02 'pot theft' premise: no path lets a non-caller extract an honest caller's ETH. Relevant as an aggravator: DEDUP-001's stranded token and DEDUP-002's dust are permanent because there is no sweep.
severityRationale: No rescue path for mistakenly-sent tokens. The 'pot theft' premise was refuted (no path lets a non-caller take an honest caller's ETH). Kept as QA; it is the aggravator that makes M-01's strand permanent, so the M-01 fix should include a sweep.
recommendation: Optional owner sweep for non-strategy tokens/ERC1155 ids (owner trusted, Law 3).
